guide.dimensionalfluxminer.cover.subtitl: A manual for those who hate digging
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.cover.intro: Here live the secrets of machines that crush, smelt and make ores appear out of nothing. Read calmly and keep grandma away from the Drain.

guide.dimensionalfluxminer.start.welcome: Some machines dig. This one §blistens§r. The Miner tunes into the frequency of the dimension it stands in and makes its ores appear out of nothing, without opening a single hole in the world. To get there you will rely on two allies: the §bDimensional Crusher§r and the §bAlloy Smelter§r. You can put the pickaxe away. Gently, it has feelings too.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.start.energy: Every machine in this guide feeds on §eenergy (FE)§r, which must come from generators of other mods. The blue bar of each machine shows how much it has stored. A machine without energy is just a very expensive, very pretty block.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.start.path:
§b1.§r Build the Crusher and the Smelter.
§b2.§r Crush iron, coal and calcite.
§b3.§r Smelt the three together and §ePure Steel§r is born.
§b4.§r With Pure Steel, forge the Reinforced Eye of Ender, the Miner parts and a core.
§b5.§r Build the Miner, hand it the core, give it power and press the button.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.start.interfa: The tabs on the sides of each machine hold its secrets: where things go in and out, details, upgrade, speed and redstone. If something goes wrong, a yellow triangle appears in the corner and tells you why. It does not judge. Much.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.start.slots: Machine slots follow the rules of a chest. Shortcut: sneak + right click with an upgrade or core in hand installs it straight into the block, no menus needed.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.start.viewer: With EMI or JEI, clicking the work chamber of a machine reveals everything it knows how to make.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.start.guide: Turn the pages with the arrows, the ←→ keys or the mouse wheel; the violet ribbon at the top goes back to the contents. Lost the book? It happens to the best explorers. A new one is born like this:
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.materials.ste: §ePure Steel§r is the only metal able to hold the flux: steel from other mods cracks under it. It is born in the Smelter from §eIron Dust, Coal Dust and Calcite Grains§r, and leaves a §eSlag§r behind, that relative who always tags along.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.materials.sla: Nothing goes to waste: nine slag form an Aggregate, which the Smelter turns back into steel. Dimensional recycling, the planet thanks you.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.materials.eye: An eye of ender armored with steel. It still points to strongholds but §enever breaks§r on the way. Finally, an eye that does not abandon you halfway through the trip.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.materials.par: Twenty-seven parts form the Miner: chassis, ventilation, reinforced glass, ports, the quantum core and the terminal. Yes, you will need a lot of steel. Yes, it is worth it.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.materials.dus: The Crusher grinds ingots, raw ores and gems into dust, and the furnace turns metal dusts back into ingots.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.crusher.about: Steel jaws that grind any precious stone into grains. Keep your fingers away.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.crusher.ores: Every crushed ore gives §edouble§r the material, or §etriple§r with the Efficiency Upgrade. It works with ores of any mod. The prettiest math in Minecraft.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.crusher.dusts: Ingots, raw ores and gems become dust. Coal and calcite become the steel ingredients.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.crusher.slots: One input and four outputs. When no output has room, it stops and the outputs turn red with embarrassment.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.crusher.sides: Items dropped on top go in by themselves, so watch what you drop nearby. In the sides tab you choose where items and energy go in and out; Auto Input and Auto Eject talk to the neighboring chests.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.crusher.speed: From level 1 to 10 it goes from 1 item every 10 seconds up to 1 280 per second. The costs are in Speed and Upgrade.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.smelter.about: A furnace without flame: three lanes of electric heat that smelt and join metals. No coal was harmed in the making of this heat.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.smelter.modes:
§bFurnace Only:§r three independent furnaces.
§bAlloy + Furnace:§r when the lanes form an alloy, it is born; otherwise each lane smelts on its own.
§bAlloy Only:§r alloys only, which sometimes leave a byproduct (like the slag of steel).
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.smelter.bulk: Raw ore pays more here: §e2 raw become 3 ingots§r, or §e1 becomes 2§r with the Efficiency Upgrade. Somewhere, a stone furnace is crying.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.smelter.split: With Auto Split on, the Smelter shares the items among the free lanes by itself. Fairer than most pizza splits.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.smelter.outpu: Each lane has its own output. An alloy uses the first for its result and the second for the byproduct.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.smelter.xp: Recipe experience is kept as §eLiquid Experience§r: it leaves through pipes, or spills as orbs if the machine is broken. Breaking the Smelter just for XP is rude, but it works.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.assembly.intr: Twenty-seven parts, one single purpose. Drag the model to rotate it, look at one layer at a time and hover a part in the list to see where it lives. Spin it all you want, it does not get dizzy.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.assembly.laye:
§bBase:§r 8 Steel Chassis around, and the Terminal in the front middle.
§bMiddle:§r the Quantum Core at the heart; Ports left, right and back; Glass in front; Ventilation in the corners.
§bTop:§r Glass in the center, front and sides; Ventilation in the corners and the back middle.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.assembly.fron: The Terminal faces the front of the machine. Looking at it, the §eleft§r port drinks §benergy§r, the §eright§r one delivers the §bores§r and the §eback§r one takes §bmatter§r. Left eats, right gives, back... well, someone has to feed it.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.assembly.buil: Place the Terminal and click it: every click fits the next part from your inventory and draws outlines where the others go (red means a block is in the way). With the last part, the machine awakens. Flat-pack furniture was never this easy.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.assembly.powe: It awakens asleep: it only works after you press the power button. Redstone can put it to sleep, never wake it. Just like everyone on a Monday.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.miner.how: Channeling the very essence of the dimension, the Miner condenses the dimensional fabric and manifests the ores of that place, each according to its rarity. Every manifestation costs §e2 DM§r and energy. Without energy, without DM or with a full output, it rests. Well deserved, if you ask it.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.miner.basic: §bDimensional Drain:§r stretches invisible roots for 300 blocks and harvests the dimensional energy that keeps the land standing, column by column (§e64 DM§r each). The price: without that energy, the matter of the place decays and the land becomes §ccorrupted§r. Your neighbors may not love the new decor. The Nether and the End have nothing to drain.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.miner.stabili: §bMatter Injection:§r feed the matter port with stone and ores and it turns them into DM at once. §aThe landscape stays untouched§r, and that chest full of cobblestone is finally good for something.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.miner.matter: Every item that goes into the matter port turns into DM at once. Only matter of the dimension the Miner stands in is accepted: Nether stone does not get through Overworld customs. §bObsidian§r is the only one accepted everywhere.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.miner.termina: The Terminal screen tells how the machine is doing, which core it carries, what holds production back and how much DM is stored. It is its diary, just without secrets.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.miner.buttons:
§bPower:§r wakes the machine up and puts it to sleep.
§bFilter:§r choose the ores you want; the rest returns to the void, no tears.
§bSettings:§r Auto Input and Auto Eject link the Miner to the chests touching its ports.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.miner.redston: With Redstone Control on, a signal on the base becomes one more lock. Great for lever enthusiasts.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.miner.output: Twenty-seven output slots. When full, the Miner stops and just stares at you. Keep it empty with pipes or Auto Eject.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.dimensions.in: The Miner is §bdimensional§r: the dimension it stands in decides which ores it manifests and which matter it accepts. Matter from another dimension does not get through the port, however hard you insist.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.dimensions.ov: Both cores work here. The §bBasic Core§r drains the energy of the land and §cDimensional Death§r spreads. The §bStabilized Core§r accepts stone, cobblestone, deepslate, granite, diorite, andesite and dirt, plus the ores born in the Overworld.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.dimensions.ne: The Nether was born corrupted: there is nothing left to drain, so §eonly the Stabilized Core§r works here, and the Miner corrupts nothing. It accepts netherrack, basalt, blackstone, nylium and magma blocks (§e0.5 DM§r), glowstone, soul sand and soul soil (§e1 DM§r), nether bricks (§e1.5 DM§r) and the Nether's own ores.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.dimensions.en: The End has nothing left to lose either: §eonly the Stabilized Core§r works, corrupting nothing. It accepts end stone and purpur blocks (§e0.5 DM§r) and the ores born in the End.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.dimensions.eg: §bDragon egg:§r you beat the dragon, put the egg on a shelf and now you look at it thinking of DM? The Miner takes it: §e10 DM§r in one go. There is no other one, there are no refunds, and the dragon, wherever it is, is judging you.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.dimensions.di: These are only the best-known materials. The matter of each dimension hides in many shapes: cut, polished, shaped by builders' hands. Bring to the Miner's port whatever you find along the way; it knows what belongs to its place.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.dimensions.or: An ore only becomes matter in the dimension where it is born, and only that variant: Overworld diamond ore does not get into the Nether, and Nether quartz does not get into the Overworld. If a mod generates that same ore in another dimension, it counts there too. This applies to the matter port and to the automatic input from chests alike.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.dimensions.ob:
§bObsidian§r has always defied conventional physics. The same raw dimensional properties that stabilize and tear open the rifts to other planes keep its crystal structure suspended in a constant temporal limbo.
Bound to the laws of no single reality, it turns into matter in §eany dimension§r without decay or collapse: §e1 DM§r everywhere. What sustains this timeless resonance is still a mystery... Further studies are advised before any large-scale application.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.dimensions.mo: In dimensions of other mods, the Miner manifests and accepts the ores born there. Which stones of each world also count as matter? That is for explorers to find out.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.dimensions.ta: The value of every item is in the table of the Running the Miner chapter.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.rates.intro: There is no speed upgrade to craft here. Every machine has a §bSpeed selector from 1 to 10§r (the tab with colored strips: left click goes up, right click goes down) and sips FE at whatever pace you ask. Your power generation is the boss, not your crafting table: early on it works slowly on a simple generator; late game, with a reactor, it flies. The same machine follows you from the first ingot to the last dragon.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.rates.buffer: Each level up asks for 2 to 2.5 times more energy and works faster in the same proportion. The internal storage holds 10 ticks of the selected level, and the machine only charges for the work it really does: when idle, it spends nothing. Lowering the level never throws energy away.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.rates.miner_n: Ores and DM per second at full power. From level 6 to 9 the Miner charges §edouble§r: haste is expensive. The Efficiency Upgrade does not change its thirst.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.rates.crusher: Operations/s = items crushed per second. At level 10 it goes past a thousand per second: bring pipes that can keep up.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.rates.smelter: Items per second of each lane for a common furnace recipe (10 s); there are 3 lanes. Shorter recipes run even faster, but every slot holds only 64 items.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.rates.upgrade: One single, expensive upgrade that goes into the Upgrade tab (or sneak + right click on the machine).

§bCrusher:§r half the energy and 3 products per ore instead of 2.
§bSmelter:§r half the energy and a raw bonus of 1 → 2 instead of 2 → 3.
§bMiner:§r energy unchanged; every item in the Matter Input gives +0.5 DM, and every ore discarded by the filter returns DM (up to 2 DM).
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.blight.intro: The Drain takes its toll. Dimensional energy is the glue that holds the whole world together; where the Drain harvests it, the structure of the place falls apart, life withers and the land rots forever. Think twice before installing it next to grandma's house.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.blight.terrai: Dirt, grass and stone darken; sand and gravel become §eCorrupted Sediment§r. Dimensional Death reaches through trees and buildings, and flowers turn into wither roses. A lovely gift for people you do not like.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.blight.water: Water touched by Dimensional Death turns purple and sinks, corrupting the water below it, layer by layer. No land plant drinks from it; only sea life endures. No, it is not grape juice.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.blight.creatu: Corrupted water hurts players and peaceful creatures but is a balm for hostile ones. You would not want to face a drowned bathed in it.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.blight.avoid: Want to mine without hurting the land? The Stabilized Dimensional Core never touches the environment. The server's environmentalists approve.
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.miner.matter_: §bOres§r only count in the dimension where they are born: §e0.5 DM§r each; diamond and uranium §e1 DM§r; emerald, platinum and ancient debris §e2 DM§r (+0.5 with the upgrade).

§bWith the Efficiency Upgrade§r, every injected item gives §e+0.5 DM§r on top of its value (the last column of the table). On top of that, the ores the filter would discard are not lost: they come back as DM (up to 2 DM each).
guide.dimensionalfluxminer.smelter.multi:
Use both machines together and every ore gives far more than the 1 ingot of a common furnace:
§bNo upgrades:§r 1 ore → 2 raw → §e3 ingots§r.
§bUpgrade in the Crusher only:§r 1 ore → 3 raw → §e4.5 ingots§r.
§bUpgrade in the Smelter only:§r 1 ore → 2 raw → §e4 ingots§r.
§bUpgrade in both:§r 1 ore → 3 raw → §e6 ingots§r.
This applies to ores that become raw ore, like iron, gold and copper.
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.root.d: Some machines dig. This one listens.
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.crushe: Build a Dimensional Crusher. The stones of the world are already nervous.
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.smelte: Build an Alloy Smelter. The stone furnace is already updating its résumé.
Forge your first Pure Steel. Tough as nails, literally. The Flux Guide comes as a gift.
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.slag_r: Turn Slag Aggregate back into steel. Even leftovers deserve a second chance.
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.reinfo: Give the eye of ender a suit of steel armor. It had it coming.
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.strong: Finally, an eye that does not abandon you halfway through the trip.
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.miner_: Twenty-seven parts and no screws left over. A miracle!
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.first_: An ore that sprouted out of nowhere, and not a single pickaxe involved.
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.ore_fi: Use the Miner filter. That ore failed the job interview.
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.max_sp: Speed 10. Your power bill sends its regards.
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.thousa: Over a thousand operations per second, for 5 seconds in a row. The server is breaking a sweat.
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.effici: It cost a dragon, an enchanted apple and a piece of your soul.
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.matter: Mining without making a mess: cobblestone goes in, matter comes out, and nature never notices.
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.trash_: Turn 10 000 cobblestone into Dimensional Matter. Finally a use for that pile of cobblestone.
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.column: The first column drained. The land felt it, and did not like it.
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.scorch: Step on corrupted dirt. That is not fertilizer.
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.purple: A dip in corrupted water: refreshing, purple and mildly deadly.
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.warden: Saw a Warden healing in corrupted water? It will not thank you. Run.
advancements.dimensionalfluxminer.world_: Half of the whole area around the Miner drained to the last drop. The cartographer quit.
tag.entity_type.dimensionalfluxminer.cor: Healed a heart by Corrupted Water
